The petitioner is the accused in CC No.27/2023 on the files of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court II, Mavelikkara, which arose out of Crime No.1236/19 of Nooranadu Police Station, Alappuzha,
wherein he was arraigned as the 3rd accused.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court II, Mavelikkara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offences alleged against him as well as the other accused are under Sections 294(b), 323, 324 and 498A IPC read with Section 34 IPC.
 2.
The prosecution case pertains to the matrimonial cruelty perpetrated by the 1st accused in the crime upon his wife.
The petitioner herein is the brother of the 1st accused.
3. The accused Nos.1 and 2 faced the trial in CC No.63/2021.
The case against the present petitioner was split up, since his presence could not be procured during the trial in the said case.
After the completion of trial, the learned Magistrate acquitted accused Nos.1 and 2 in CC No.63/2021 as per judgment dated 17.01.2023.
However, the case against the present petitioner was refiled and renumbered as CC No.27/2023.

In the present petition, the petitioner would contend that the proceedings against him are liable to be 2025:KER:39889 quashed since the Trial Court has already found that the offence alleged in this Crime is not attracted.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.  5. A perusal of judgment rendered by the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court II, Mavelikkara, on 17.01.2023 in CC No.63/2021, would go to show that the accused Nos.1 and 2 were acquitted after arriving at a definite finding that there is absolutely no evidence to establish the matrimonial cruelty attributed against all accused.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court II, Mavelikkara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is also pertinent to note that the three witnesses, including the de facto complainant, examined in the aforesaid case, had turned against the prosecution and deposed that the accused did not commit any such offence as alleged in this case.

Thus, it is apparent that the entire substratum of the prosecution case has been collapsed by the evidence rendered by the pivotal witnesses to the effect that the accused did not commit any offence as alleged in the Final Report.
In that view of the matter, there is absolutely no purpose to be fulfilled by the continuance of the prosecution against the present petitioner, who is the accused in CC No.27/2023.
Needless to say that termination of the 2025:KER:39889 prosecution proceedings in the said case is highly necessary to prevent the abuse of process of law.
In the result, the petition stands allowed.

The proceedings against the petitioner/accused in CC No.27/2023 on the files of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II, Mavelikkara (3rd accused in Cr.No.1236/2019 of Nooranadu Police Station, Alappuzha), are hereby quashed.
